lookahead_policy: observation_timestamp_utc MUST equal information_cutoff_utc and every bound source capture or verification timestamp MUST be at or before that cutoff
source_binding_policy: Every core family MUST bind exact paths, SHA-256 values, owner/provider/transform contracts and a reachable ancestor Git commit under SHARED_ROW_SOURCE_BINDING_MANIFEST_v1.
revision_policy: use only information available by cutoff; later revisions must be separately versioned and may not rewrite a frozen row
